question: How do Qwen3-32B TP1/PP4 modeled healthy and source-worker-failure WCT vary over a full system-DP by context matrix under same-node and cross-node protection?
selection_policy: All 300 cells, all three paired seeds, all contexts, scales, topologies, and both policies are retained. There is no performance-direction threshold.

profile_gate_resolution.resolution: This separately identified preliminary is authorized only as MODELED_ANALYTIC_WEIGHT_RATIO_NOT_PHYSICAL; it does not satisfy or replace a matched A100 profile.

model.capacity_stage_rule: use the maximum of the four exact stage partitions for every representative stage rank; conservative and not outcome-selected

service_model.weight_ratio_formula: Qwen3-32B total weight bytes / Qwen3-8B total weight bytes
service_model.coefficient_formula: each Qwen3-8B modeled coefficient multiplied by the frozen total-weight ratio
service_model.pp_latency_abstraction: coefficients represent end-to-end serialization across four stages; simulator lanes are logical pipeline replicas and do not claim measured PP microbatch overlap
service_model.recompute_formula: prefill_setup_ms + recomputed_tokens * prefill_ms_per_token using the same registered analytic coefficients

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA A100 40GB modeled as 40 GiB addressable HBM per physical PP-stage GPU
hardware.logical_rank_semantics: one complete TP1/PP4 pipeline replica; capacity and protection bytes use one conservative representative physical stage GPU
hardware.placement: each pipeline occupies four contiguous GPUs; two complete pipeline replicas per 8-GPU node
hardware.fault_abstraction: a source_worker_gpu event invalidates one logical pipeline because loss of any one PP stage makes that pipeline unavailable; failed physical GPU count is one

same_node.peer_rule: the other complete PP4 pipeline in the same 8-GPU node; stage-aligned physical copy
same_node.dram_rule: CPU DRAM attached to the source node

cross_node.peer_rule: stage-aligned pipeline target on the next physical node ring
cross_node.dram_rule: CPU DRAM attached to the next physical node

capacity_equation.no_oracle: dispatch never reads realized output length or realized service time
capacity_equation.analytic_gate: two max-context conservative serving reservations fit before dynamic Peer-HBM backup reclaim

workload.probe_schedule: policy-free deterministic probes from the common no-oracle workload universe, paired across policy and topology
workload.primary_denominator: all workflows in the identical condition-seed universe

primary: healthy all-workflow mean and p99 WCT
same-probe source-worker-failure all-workflow mean and p99 WCT
throughput, queue, capacity blocks, copy/reclaim/recovery counts

figure_grammar.layout: 2x2: same/cross-node paired mean-WCT reduction across all contexts, plus absolute fault-WCT at the preregistered 16K context
figure_grammar.context_encoding: five fixed colors, no result-dependent omission
figure_grammar.error_bars: paired or architecture Student-t 95% CI across three seeds
figure_grammar.panel_text_boundary: no preliminary, seed, hash, or evidence prose in panels

hard_gates: protocol tests pass before full raw
workflow universe and fault probe hashes match across policy and topology for each condition and seed
no-oracle predicted slack lineage is used; core.build_workload oracle lineage is fail-closed
source_worker_gpu invalidates exactly one logical pipeline and one physical PP-stage GPU
PP4 placement fills complete 8-GPU nodes with two pipelines per node
same/cross topology is bijective and uses separately registered directional bandwidth
every capacity record obeys the conservative physical stage-GPU 40 GiB equation
copy bytes and physical target accounting conserve exactly
empty fault replay is exact and fault replay never lowers WCT
no performance direction, seed, context, DP, topology, or policy selection
single-page vector PDF, at least 1800 px PNG, minimum font at least 7 pt
evidence_boundary: Three-seed cold-start-inclusive metadata DES preliminary using a modeled analytic Qwen3-32B service profile. Weight, PP layout, per-stage KV bytes, and A100 40 GiB capacity are frozen; service coefficients, bandwidth, 500 ms activation, and 60 s Native replacement are modeled/unmeasured. This is not a matched A100 profile, physical measurement, or paper-ready evidence.
